decisions.decision: Build it now. In cloud/funnel/worker.js and the Zoom attendance job, once each session ends (meeting.ended, or the next attendance pull), call GET /report/meetings/{meetingId}/polls and fall back to GET /past_meetings/{meetingUUID}/polls if that fails. Match each answer to a registrant by email. Store the poll 4 answer through the same code path the WebinarGeek poll_votes handler uses, so the almost-buyer rule (attended, said yes in poll 4, not booked two hours later) fires for both platforms. Add a Zoom poll-report fixture to the sim. Write a probe in which a test Zoom meeting's poll 4 yes marks the registrant, and check that the almost-buyer email gets queued in the sim. Change the D2.23 field copy so it no longer says WebinarGeek only. Use git stash for worker.js WIP and commit only your hunk. Run the Fable critic, push, deploy the centre and log in coord/LOG.md. If live Zoom is missing a report or poll-read scope, note that on T-417's existing sign-in. Do not open a new ask.
decisions.why: Assigned to Claude and fully buildable. done_when is proven in the sim. The 2026-10-22 handoff and series-deck memory list this as a build gap. Zoom scopes already sit in T-417 (the T-226/T-407 decisions), so Adi needs to give no new input.
